s1.syndrome_frame: Intermittent confusion and falls in an elderly patient with cardiac history and evidence of conduction abnormalities
salient_findings: Prolongation of the His-His interval on intracardiac recordings
key_facts: Patient is in their mid-80s
Complaints of intermittent confusion and falls
Medical history of moderate aortic stenosis
Medical history of renal cell carcinoma treated with radical nephrectomy, chemotherapy, and radiation
Alert, fully oriented, and in no acute distress on presentation
Heart rate of 89 beats/min
Blood pressure of 127/58 mm Hg
Frequent pauses noted on telemetry
ECG findings of atrioventricular block
Intracardiac recordings showing prolongation of the His-His interval
Echocardiogram showing preserved biventricular systolic function and moderate aortic stenosis
